area: Testbed audit: weapons and enemies tuning bands

find.report_claim: cycle 202 swept engagement.json and levels.json; weapons.json and enemies.json were the last tuning documents without a full sweep
find.live_evidence: a 12-case full-suite sweep doubled one value per weapon/enemy: 7 were caught, 5 survived with all 778 tests green

killed: pinning raw literals: observable bands on tracers, HP loss, hit count, falloff damage and boss cooldown were used
aiming down the arena centre for the falloff probe: the cover at z=-10 blocked the ray; the probe uses a clear lane at x=15 from z=19 to z=-19 (38 m)
using a single enemy for the lance damage probe: hits sometimes landed on the second enemy in a line, so the probe reads the maximum HP drop across three aligned targets
